summary: **Solar System Pirates** is an interactive website that tells the stories of the equipment left behind by NASA missions on the Moon and Mars. Through this project, we explore what these objects were used for, why they were left behind, and how they helped scientists learn more about space. By using interactive features and 3D models, we make these forgotten pieces of space history easier and more interesting to discover. Our goal is to bring these objects back into the spotlight and show that even though they were left behind, their stories are still worth telling.
details:
Solar System Pirates is a website that helps people explore the history of space missions in an interesting and interactive way. We wanted to create something more than just a website with information, so we added different features that make learning about space more enjoyable.

Users can explore a 3D model of the solar system, learn about eight pieces of equipment left behind by NASA missions, and see their stories through interactive 3D models. The website also includes a map showing equipment locations on the Moon, information about the Spirit and Opportunity Mars rovers, a mission timeline, and a short quiz.

We built the project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Three.js. We also used NASA resources and scientific records to collect information and make the content more reliable.

What makes our project different is that it combines space history, 3D exploration, and learning in one place. Our main goal is to help people discover forgotten space equipment and understand the stories behind it in a fun and simple way.
